notes.title: Localization update is here!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

The Localization Update is here! 




[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45218034/6887b1d9dc7941a89bea8ca902adf4c253c20404.png"]


Over the past two months, together with the translators, we managed to add several new languages to the game. Here’s the list included in this update:
Spanish

Portuguese (Brazilian)

Korean

Simplified Chinese

French

Italian

Ukrainian

Turkish

Getting the full localization done wasn’t easy, but thanks to the amazing translators who approached it very professionally, we made it! If you notice any issues or errors with the new languages, I’d really appreciate it if you could share your feedback on Discord so I can continue improving the game.

The update also brings a few smaller improvements and bug fixes!


Future Plans
I know there are still many more languages to add, and I hope to bring another batch in the future. For now, however, my focus is on the upcoming update that will add full Steam Deck support and a free content update. I don’t want to give a release date yet, as I honestly don’t know how much more time it will take, and I’d rather not rush it just to push it out quickly.



Soon I’ll be sharing more detailed information about what the content update will include, and maybe even reveal a release date. For now, thank you so much for your support, the past two months have been both amazing and a little stressful, but I’m really happy with the current state of the game!

Stay tuned for more news coming soon, and if you’d like to share feedback or keep up to date, join the Discord: https://discord.com/invite/SGfhJJ62bj


Thank you and see you around!

– Monopixel Games

notes.title: Official Trailer and Release Date Announcement!
notes.notes:
It's finally happening, the game is complete, and I’m incredibly happy to announce that it will be released on July 11th! I'm really proud of the entire production, and it brings me great joy to have finished and published the game.

As for the price, the game will be available for $4.99, with a limited-time release discount to celebrate the launch!

Once again, I want to thank everyone who helped me along the way, left feedback (which was incredibly valuable), and added the game to their wishlist. This has been a beautiful journey, one I’ll remember for a long time.

The new trailer is now live, and there's nothing more left to say except: I hope you enjoy the game! I truly hope it meets your expectations, but I’ll let you be the judge of that.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45218034/3af7944519c7cf0ba5b83734340ad87f318f20eb.png"]

With the release of the game, we’re also launching a public Discord server!

You can find me there, ask questions, share feedback, or just hang out with other players.

Thanks so much!

notes.title: Devlog Update #4!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
It’s time for Devlog 4, and it’s also the final one!

I can finally say it, the game is done!
Over the past two months, I’ve managed to polish and build something I’m genuinely proud of. I think I’ve met the challenge… but I’ll leave that for you to decide. I’m just excited to finally release my first game and watch you uncover the mystery hidden within Among Green Trees National Park.

A few important notes and updates:

First, the game is designed to take about 1.5 hours for a standard playthrough. If you're aiming to solve every puzzle or collect all achievements, you’ll probably need a bit more time.

Second, the game was originally planned to have multiple endings. But developing this game solo meant that splitting the ending into many paths would dilute the quality. So, there’s one main ending, but you can encounter optional events along the way. These don’t change the ending, but they’re a nice bonus!

Third, localization: The game will launch in English by default, but I’m also working on Chinese, Russian, and Polish versions. If everything goes smoothly (and so far, it has), expect those languages to be available at launch!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45218034/947a4df98792739e6d1a9943a576f0fdd42539cd.png

So, when’s the release date?

I’ll make an official announcement next week, along with a new trailer and release date.

Lastly, I want to thank everyone who supported me, those who shared the game, tested the demo, gave feedback, or added it to their wishlist. You helped me make it through this entire process, which wasn’t always easy, especially the last two months.
At launch, I’ll update the Steam page and share a link to the Discord server for anyone who wants to join, leave feedback, share their thoughts, or ask anything about the game.

Stay tuned for next week’s post with the official trailer and release date.

See you at launch! Over and out!

notes.title: Devlog Update #3!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!
It’s time for Devlog Update 3!

March flew by, but it was also the month where I probably added the most content to the game so far!
Last Report took part in the Steam Next Fest, and I want to give a huge thank you to everyone who added the game to their wishlist, played the demo, or left feedback. Thanks to the Fest, I managed to get a solid boost in wishlists – really appreciate it!

🛠️ What’s New, Improved & Changed:
There have been quite a few changes. I read through a lot of player feedback (thank you again!), and the game currently has an average rating of 8.14/10, which is a fantastic result for me.

✅ Key Changes:
Verification system (mini-games) – Many players found this system too repetitive or unnecessary. I’ve reworked it to be more dynamic and better integrated into gameplay.

Walkie-talkie – The system for calling other park rangers has been reworked. Now, it’s easier to actually connect with others, and there are more conversations and dialogue options.

Game map – The park has been divided into sectors, which now play a more meaningful role in gameplay.

Reports – I've added dates to reports, which now affect their validity.

New in-game computer app – This lets you monitor how accurately you’re filling out reports. It shows your work efficiency and updates periodically. I think you’ll like it!

More events and reports – I’ve expanded existing events and added new ones as well.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45218034/9d6e9acdab18c0c5b73d7de4557855a3fbef8cf4.png
🔮 What’s Next:
I don’t plan to add any major new mechanics. Everything I wanted is already in the game. From now on, it’s all about polishing and improving what's already there.

Endings & Choices – This is still a work in progress. One official ending is already in the game, but I want to add more ways to end the game based on player decisions. These won’t change everything drastically, but they will slightly impact how the story wraps up.

Gamepad support – Still on my to-do list.

Achievements & deeper Steam API integration – coming soon.

Localization – Probably my biggest fear 😅
I know a lot of people are hoping for more language support, and I totally get it – but it’s definitely not going to be easy.
I can’t make any promises just yet, but if localization does happen, I’ll make sure to keep you updated!

📅 Release Date?
Yes, I’ve already pushed the date once – and there’s still work to do.
Right now, I’m aiming for a May release, but I’ll keep you updated if anything changes.

Lastly, a huge thank you for all your support so far!
For the game’s release, I plan to set up a Discord server, in case anyone wants to ask questions, give feedback, or just hang out.

Thanks again – and see you in the next devlog update! Over And Out! :)

notes.title: Demo 2.0 Update
notes.notes:
The all-new Demo 2.0 is here, bringing a completely revamped and improved experience compared to the first demo! With tons of changes and new features, now is the perfect time to play the Last Report Demo!

What's New?

 Reworked dialogues and characters – improved writing, deeper characters, and an enhanced storyline
 Revamped computer system – a brand-new interface with its own OS, apps, windows, and a smoother report submission system
 More and better events – now with even more content!
 New lighting and visual effects
 Enhanced animations with improved sound design
 Better controls, expanded options, and improved settings


A huge thank you to everyone who played, shared feedback, and added the game to their wishlist! Your support keeps me motivated to keep pushing forward. This is a major milestone for the game, and now my focus is on delivering the full closed version. When? Probably in March/April, I’ll share more details soon.

But for now, thank you, and enjoy the new Demo!

notes.title: Devlog Update 2!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, it's time for Devlog Update 2!

February has begun, which means I'm gearing up for the Steam Next Fest. Over the past month, I've made a lot of progress, and I’m excited to share the most important changes with you. My goal is to release Demo 2.0 around February 14th to test it before the official start of the event.

What's New & Improved:

Better gameplay experience – I agree that some interactions were inconsistent. Some required pressing E, others Q, some used the mouse, and exiting the computer required clicking X. Now, everything is much more intuitive! Most interactions can be exited using Esc, dialogues can be skipped and scrolled with the mouse, and overall, the game plays much more smoothly.

More features for the in-game computer – I've added more content, and verification test mini-games have been improved. They are now more varied and less repetitive.

Enhanced horror events – I've improved existing scary moments and added new ones to make them even better. I've also included more sound effects where needed!

Cutscenes and dialogues – I've adjusted the intro cutscene, updated some dialogues, and added a few extra options for more immersion.

UI improvements for report submissions – The old UI was, to put it mildly, chaotic. Many players found it overwhelming due to excessive text and buttons. I’ve redesigned it to be more intuitive and user-friendly.
I finally feel like this is a game I can be proud of. Is it perfect? Of course not. But I believe it’s genuinely good now! My next goal is to go through the Steam Next Fest and then focus on finishing the game.

There’s not much left to do, but I’m still unsure if I’ll need to push the release date to April—I want to take my time and ensure every part of the game meets the same quality standard rather than rushing and leaving some areas feeling unfinished. I’ll share more details in the next devlog at the end of February!

A huge thank you to everyone who played, gave feedback, or added the game to their wishlist, I appreciate all of you!

See you soon!

notes.title: Devlog Update 1!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, here’s Devlog Update 1!
It’s hard to believe, but it’s already been two months since I announced the game (time flies!). During this time, I’ve been working hard on the game, and I’m really happy with the progress I’ve made and how the game has evolved. I’d like to share a few updates with you (keep in mind that these changes will only be available in the demo around February when I prepare the V2 demo for the Steam Next Fest event).

What’s new/changed:

First and foremost, I’ve revamped the dialogues. I wasn’t happy with the fact that our character couldn’t say a word, so I reworked the dialogues, and now we have full conversations. I’ve also improved the story, characters, and their behavior. It’s much less stiff now, and I experimented a bit with writing the characters and dialogues – I promise they’re much better! Also, the character animations are no longer wooden; they now react and have more poses.

Another major change is the computer interface. You now have access to the desktop with several apps. There’s a lot more, but I didn’t want to overdo it. I’ll also add that you can now interact with open windows or check important information around the park.

I’ve added new types of reports, more events, and several quality-of-life improvements. Unfortunately, I don’t want to spoil too much for now, but believe me, there’s a lot happening!

There are still a few more things I’d like to change, but I feel like I’m on the right track to finish the game by February/March.

As always, I’d like to thank everyone for playing, for the feedback, and for adding the game to your wishlist. It really helps keep me motivated to continue working on it (and believe me, it’s not always easy!).

Thank you all, and I wish you a Merry Christmas and Happy Holidays! See you soon (probably in January)!
